selection_basis: S2 segmented-v4 completed one exact terminal run with four provider calls and nine canonical artifacts
the S2 strict named-tool route was retired after repeated malformed-output and terminalization failures
the OpenAI route did not reach generation under the available credentials
S3 must keep node-specific local schema authority rather than relax the canonical three-cell output contract

observed_facts: the T08 proof case exists only in an isolated deterministic fixture and is not a reusable live admission identity
no FINSIGHT_P02_FIXTURE_ROOT is configured for one persistent S3 anchor Case
the S3 input pack is currently compiled inside _S3ThreeCellBoundedAgentAdapter.execute after WorkUnit Attempt and ResearchRun creation
the input digest includes T02 through T07 lineage that is bound to work_unit_id attempt_id and research_run_id
there is no public zero-call S3 prepare function or exact-admission runner that predicts identities compiles the pack and verifies digest parity before canonical execution
required_repair: add one read-only S3 exact-input prepare path using the existing Fin01ResearchRuntime compilers and no parallel runtime family
bind one persistent isolated NVDA S3 Case accepted DecisionSurface version and analysis as-of
derive the fresh WorkUnit Attempt and ResearchRun identities before execution from the frozen idempotency key
compile T02 through T07 and the S3 input pack twice and require byte-stable digest parity
reject any admission whose runtime-built input digest differs from the prepared digest before the first provider call

observed_facts: S3ThreeCellAgentNodeExecutorPort has only the T08 zero-call test fixture implementation
build_bounded_agent_executor_for_admission builds only the historical S2 DeepSeekBoundedAgentExecutor
create_app requires an explicitly injected S3 executor and has no exact-admission factory for the six-node provider path
required_repair: implement one DeepSeek segmented node executor for the exact six S3 nodes
use node-specific closed JSON shapes with native JSON duplicate-key rejection and local semantic validation
return one usage receipt and exact Agent and Skill version bindings per node
enforce one transport attempt per node retry zero and aggregate six-call cost and token caps
prove malformed specialist Lead Writer and Verifier outputs fail before canonical artifact commit

decision.reason: An exact admission cannot be signed while its provider node implementation and immutable input digest are unknown. Both are project-owned zero-call prerequisites and must be repaired before any paid call.
